name: Gold digger
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on July 17th, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 7 of the July 2020 Challenge B.
This paint can also currently be obtained from the "First Purchase Bonus" offer on mobile.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
Though not considered a notable discovery at the time, the design for this paint proved to be one of the most valuable things found in a California river in 1949.
